state.objective: Collect every dot without being caught. Ghosts are controlled by deterministic game code.

move.instructions: Control Pac-Man to collect dots and avoid ghosts. First avoid being caught this turn, including the programmed ghost move on even-numbered turns. Among safe moves, minimize maze distance to a remaining dot without crossing a ghost's current tile. Then prefer greater distance from the nearest ghost. Break remaining ties in order: up, down, left, right.
move.label: up
